Our objective is to empower all our developers to build and own their systems end-to-end. We're a modern infrastructure engineering team, believing strongly in testing, automation, and standardization through software. We operate in both physical data centers and AWS environments, and leverage open source technologies such as containers, MariaDB, NGINX, Jenkins, and Chef, as well as build tools and services using Go and Java to deliver automated infrastructure to our engineers and ultimately serve our clients. With high quality software as our ultimate engineering objective, our key tactic is automation: Wealthfront software automates the financial services we provide to our clients, and within these services we automate the collection of data that we learn from on our way to making our services even better. Wealthfront engineers function as builder/operators, with dual responsibility for building the system and operating it in production. Any toil that this brings about is automated away by engineers. This investment in automation is expected, and the prioritization of it is always built into our planning and execution. Wealthfront engineers automate our development processes. For example, Wealthfront engineers automate all of our testing. Manual testing is not part of the software development lifecycle at Wealthfront. Wealthfront engineers automate observability in case of failure. If something is up, our systems inform engineers appropriately. If our systems are quiet, they are healthy. Benefits include medical, vision, dental, 401K plan, generous time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursements, professional development, employee investing discount, and more! Plus, with our Cash Account, they can earn a high yield (from program banks) until the minute they’re ready to invest. review_candidates.title: iOS QA Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Role CallApp is seeking a skilled iOS QA Engineer to ensure the quality of our caller ID and call blocking app serving millions of users worldwide. Help us deliver exceptional iOS experiences across the Apple ecosystem. What you'll do Own the QA process for the entire iOS stack, including SwiftUI app, Call Directory & CallKit extensions, Widgets, and Live Activities. Review product specifications and technical designs, proactively identifying potential testability issues and edge-case scenarios. Create clear and detailed test plans, as well as exploratory test charters, covering a range of iPhone form factors and scenarios. Perform comprehensive manual testing, including functional, usability, accessibility, and network condition testing. Clearly trace, reproduce, and document issues using Jira, supported by videos, logs, and precise reproduction steps. Execute thorough regression testing on every release candidate and validate hotfixes via TestFlight. Monitor production environments (Crashlytics, Firebase, Analytics), analyzing issues and collaborating with engineers on root cause investigations. Advocate for best practices in quality engineering and contribute actively to our growing QA team. What you bring Strong communication skills and meticulous attention to detail. 2+ years of experience in iOS mobile QA. Hands-on experience testing consumer facing iOS applications. Nice to have Familiarity with CallKit, Contacts, VoIP, telecom systems, or spam blocking domains. Expertise in performance analysis, battery consumption, and memory profiling. Proficiency in Swift programming and scripting in Bash for automation and tooling. Previous experience working with apps used by millions of users. Why join CallApp? Impact at scale: Your work directly protects millions from spam calls and shapes a modern, legacy-free iOS codebase. Top-tier team: Collaborate daily with passionate, experienced iOS engineers who deeply value quality. Financially strong and growing: Profitable business with a global presence, offering ample greenfield opportunities for innovation. Competitive benefits: Attractive salary, dog friendly workspace, and gym facilities. Apply via email to alon@callapp.com or see the listing at callapp.com/jobs.

review_candidates.title: Work in Portugal
review_candidates.description: Lavora in Portogallo Ti piacerebbe iniziare a esplorare il mondo? Sei alla ricerca della tua prima esperienza lavorativa? Desideri cambiare carriera, dare una svolta alla tua vita o semplicemente trasferirti all'estero? Ti offriamo uno splendido alloggio a Lisbona a prezzi super convenienti (grazie a un fantastico sconto aziendale riservato come benefit), un ambiente di lavoro internazionale e un ufficio pazzesco a due passi dalla spiaggia a Lisbona! Stiamo selezionando professionisti italiani dinamici per unirsi a team globali nel cuore del Portogallo. Questa è l'opportunità perfetta per chi cerca un cambiamento radicale o vuole iniziare il proprio percorso professionale in un ambiente stimolante e multiculturale. Il meglio di tutto questo? Decidi tu! Lavora al 100% da remoto da qualsiasi parte del Portogallo continentale, oppure vieni a trovarci nei nostri moderni uffici a Lisbona... inclusi i nostri incredibili uffici sulla spiaggia (beach offices) ! Cosa ti offriamo? (Pacchetto di Benvenuto e Alloggio) : Ti supportiamo fin dal primo giorno! Alloggio iniziale : 2 settimane di hotel gratuite al tuo arrivo per permetterti di ambientarti senza stress. Alloggio aziendale scontato : Un benefit speciale! Ti offriamo una sistemazione a Lisbona a un prezzo super accessibile, gestita direttamente dall'azienda per azzerare le spese eccessive del mercato immobiliare. Supporto amministrativo : Gestiamo noi tutta la burocrazia, i documenti locali (NIF/NISS) e la contrattualistica. Stipendio competitivo : Retribuzione attrattiva e fortemente competitiva sul mercato portoghese. Chi stiamo cercando? (Requisiti) : Lingua: Italiano a livello madrelingua o fluente (C1/C2). Inglese: Livello minimo B2 (necessario per la formazione e la comunicazione interna). Competenze: Eccellenti doti comunicative, orientamento al cliente e forte flessibilità. Mindset: Spirito di squadra, curiosità verso il mondo e tanta motivazione a vivere un'esperienza multiculturale sotto il sole! Pronto/a a metterti in gioco? Candidati ora inviando il tuo CV in inglese e prepara le valigie! Welcome to Portugal!

review_candidates.title: Transport & Installation Manager/Engineer d/f/m - Foundations
review_candidates.description: RWE Renewables Japan G.K. To start as soon as possible, full time, permanent Do you want to help deliver a low carbon future? Do you want to help develop innovative, sustainable solutions to the technical challenges facing offshore wind and help drive for a renewables powered future? If so we would like to invite you to join our Installation Logistics team here at RWE Offshore. As our next T&I Manager you will integrate into, and work as part of, the wider Engineering Department to support global offshore wind projects at all lifecycle stages. You will work every day with an exciting and diverse team who push the boundaries and set the standards for T&I amongst our peers. You will develop, innovate, optimise and then manage the execution of T&I solutions within our offshore wind projects that will ensure we deliver on our promise of a sustainable future. If you would like to be part of our journey then please bring your experience and enthusiasm into play and help us deliver a net zero future. About The Role Support procurement in preparing foundation installation contracts, technical specifications, and vessel charters. Assess and evaluate transport and installation technologies, methodologies, and commercial solutions. Collaborate with foundation, electrical/cable, and turbine package teams to develop optimized transport and installation concepts. Implement approved transport and installation strategies with contractors following contract award and act as Installation Manager/Engineer during project execution. Manage Transport & Installation contracts after Final Investment Decision (FID), ensuring effective contractor performance and delivery. Lead the planning, technical definition, reporting, and execution of foundation transport and installation activities, including marshalling port operations, offshore installation, and handovers, in compliance with HSE and company standards. Review and approve installation documentation, including method statements, risk assessments, lift plans, permits to work, and safety procedures. Manage interfaces with authorities, government bodies, and internal stakeholders while supporting innovation initiatives to advance transport and installation solutions. Job Requirements And Experience Degree in Naval Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Marine Logistics, Renewable Energy, or a related discipline. Significant experience in the development and/or construction of offshore wind farm projects, with expertise in transporting large structures, ideally offshore wind turbine foundations. Proven experience in offshore foundation installation, including monopiles, pin piles, pile driving techniques, and grouting applications. Demonstrated track record in delivering Transport & Installation package management or construction logistics scopes within offshore wind. Experience managing offshore construction contracts and vessel chartering, with an interest in project management and engineering interfaces. Strong communication, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multinational team. Willingness to travel within Japan and internationally, and to work offshore and at heights as required. Fluent in English; Japanese language skills and experience working with Japanese suppliers, authorities, and stakeholders are highly desirable. From here, you benefit from many further advantages – Curious? Then click here! Apply with just a few clicks: ad code 93082 . Any questions? Contact HR: Sebastian Emmelot, Sebastian.Emmelot@rwe.com, Contact Business: Markus Kleine-Finke. We look forward to meeting you. Of course, you can find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Xing, too. We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, disability, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, age, sexual orientation, and identity. #inclusionmatters As a global leader, RWE Offshore Wind is shaping tomorrow's energy on the high seas. We are active across Europe, U.S., Japan and Korea. We have already 19 wind farms in operation with an installed capacity of over 3 gigawatts. With over 20 years’ experience in developing, building, operating and maintaining offshore wind farms we have established long-term partnerships, working hand in hand with local businesses and communities. Every year, we invest millions of euros in new offshore wind projects and support harbours, educational programmes, local organisations and more. Our passionate workforce is committed to driving technological and sustainable improvements, delivering construction projects on time and within budget to the highest quality and safety standards, and contributing to a clean energy future. Want to learn more about working for RWE Offshore? Join Our Journey Offshore by watching the miniseries including 6 episodes, 5 ambassadors and one exciting trip Offshore.

review_candidates.description: Výroba nám roste – přidejte se k týmu, který má smysl Naše zakázková výroba v Brně jede na plné obrátky a my hledáme nové kolegy do oddělení High Voltage Products. Pracujeme na špičkových technologiích – od komponentů pro plynem izolovaná zařízení (GIS) až po chladicí systémy. A právě teď máte šanci být u toho. Proč právě k nám? Věříme v zdravý rozum, vzájemnou podporu a efektivní práci. Díky tomu u nás panuje přátelská atmosféra a lidé zůstávají dlouhodobě. Náš tým tvoří strojní i stavební inženýři, kteří se skvěle doplňují. Navíc se podílíme na unikátním výrobním procesu, který je v Česku naprosto výjimečný – a ve světě jen málokde k vidění. Co vás čeká? Budete spolupracovat s kolegy ze Švýcarska a Švédska na velkých mezinárodních projektech – například na větrných elektrárnách v Severním moři. Vaše práce bude mít skutečný dopad. Vaše Role Příprava výrobní dokumentace pro ocelové konstrukce na globální projekty (větrné elektrárny, jaderné elektrárny, ropné plošiny) Tvorba výkresů a 3D modelů v Tekla Structures Statické a dynamické výpočty v SCIA Engineer Posuzování svarových a šroubových spojů v IdeaStatika Spolupráce s brněnským týmem i kolegy ze zahraničí (Švýcarsko, USA, Indie) Podílení se na vývoji nástrojů a zlepšování procesů Koho hledáme? Absolventy technických oborů (SŠ/VŠ), ideálně se zájmem o ocelové konstrukce – praxe je výhodou, ale ne podmínkou Kolegy, kteří dokážou převzít odpovědnost za projekt a dotáhnout ho do funkčního řešení Znalost Tekla Structures, SCIA Engineer nebo IdeaStatika je výhodou – pokud je neznáte, rádi vás zaučíme Systémové myšlení, pečlivost a chuť učit se nové věci Aktivní znalost nemeckého jazyka Proč se přidat k nám do Hitachi Energy? Firemní kulturu, která staví na lidských hodnotách, vzájemné spolupráci, hledání smysluplných a efektivních řešení Perspektivu k profesnímu i osobnímu růstu (máme funkční kariérní plány) Velký tým, kde najdete jak seniorní kolegy, co u nás pracují i 10 let, tak i juniorní kolegy a ko-legyně Jistotu úspěšné globální firmy s inovativním přístupem a zaměřením na modernizaci provozů (máme vlastní engineering, výrobu a prodej). 5 týdnů dovolené 7,5 hodin pružné pracovní doby Narozeninové volno Stravenky v hodnotě 110 Kč – plně hrazené námi Cafeteria systém nebo multisport kartu ve výši 7000 Kč ročně Příspěvek na penzijní připojištění 2–3 % ze mzdy Mobilní SIM karty se zvýhodněným paušálem Odměny za odpracované roky, při odchodu do důchodu, další benefity dle kolektivní smlouvy Publication date : 2026-09-29

review_candidates.title: Staff Optical Communications Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Ephemeris Net We are extending the internet to space. Ephemeris Net is a pre-seed space networking company on a mission to provide connectivity for all space users through collaborative engineering of commercial space networking solutions. We are creating the infrastructure that will enable the space internet beyond bent pipe by laying the foundational networking infrastructure that will define how data moves through space. We are supported by our parent incubator Second Order Effects, institutional VCs, and our network of space advisors. As space use scales and more space native networks come online, we believe that now is the chance to build foundational infrastructure for how the internet will work in space. The Role We are looking for an Optical Engineer to own the design, build, test, and flight of the optical systems that move data through the Ephemeris Net network, including coherent optical transceivers and the free-space optical assembly that pairs with it. You will own optical hardware end to end, across both the transceiver and the free-space link. On the transceiver side, this is the fiber optical signal chain: optical modulators, optical hybrids, photodiodes, lasers, fiber splitters, beam splitters. On the free-space side, this includes telescopes/beam expanders, lenses, mirrors and involves ray tracing, tolerancing, and stray light analysis required to close link budgets in orbit. You will be supported by the electrical engineering team for optoelectronic design and a mechanical team for opto-mechanical structure. You will build and fly some of the most sensitive optical hardware ever deployed in space and then scale it to mass manufacturing. This role will report to the CTO and founder, Nicolas Brown. Key Responsibilities Optical System Design & Build Design and assemble coherent transceiver optics from components: optical modulators, optical hybrids, photodetectors Design the free-space optical assembly including optical design and ray tracing: tolerancing, ghost analysis, and stray light analysis to close on-orbit link budgets Design the fiber optical layout, including alignment fixtures and opto-mechanical packaging Own the transmit and receive signal chain performance from RF electrical output through free-space launch and from free-space back to RF electrical Test & Characterization Develop and execute bench-level test plans for the transceiver and free-space assembly: modulation quality (EVM, constellation diagrams), wavefront quality, noise figure, bandwidth, optical power budgets, thermalization Characterize coherent detection performance: receiver sensitivity, common-mode rejection, and phase noise Verify free-space optical performance: wavefront error, encircled energy, pointing stability, stray light rejection Minimum Qualifications What We're Looking For Bachelor’s degree in optical engineering, applied physics, photonics, electrical engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) 4+ years of hands-on experience designing or building robust, precision electro-optical instruments in fiber, free space, or both Working knowledge of one or more areas: coherent detection architectures (IQ modulation/demodulation, balanced detection, optical hybrid operation), free-space optical design (ray tracing, tolerancing, stray light), or laser and fiber systems at the component level Proficiency with optical instrumentation (OSAs, power meters, interferometers, collimated beams, wavefront sensors, beam profilers) and RF and microwave test equipment (network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, high-speed oscilloscopes) Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance Preferred Qualifications Experience with optical design and ray tracing software including stray light and ghost analysis Experience designing telescopes, beam expanders, or pointing and tracking optical paths with cameras Familiarity with space-qualified hardware design, environmental testing (thermal, vibration, radiation), or flight heritage optical systems Experience specifying analog PCB requirements for high-bandwidth RF signal chains (TIA, driver amplifiers, bias networks) Active security clearance What We Offer Compensation and Benefits: Salary dependent on experience (please note that all posted levels for this role route through the same review process; applying to multiple levels will result in duplicate applications) Engineer II: $150,000 - $190,000 Senior Engineer: $170,000 - $210,000 Staff Engineer: $200,000 - $250,000 Generous equity package (early team member level) 401k program Comprehensive health care coverage Unlimited PTO (we expect you to take at least 4 weeks per year, and leadership does the same) Work Environment Hybrid work model: 3 days per week in our office/lab based on project needs During critical phases: When we are in integration, test, or launch prep mode, expect to be in the office more frequently for coordination with the mission team Expected travel: Up to 25% (customer meetings, supplier visits, launch campaign, partner sites, integration sites, other Ephemeris offices) Small team environment Autonomy and space to define how we work and execute. The Opportunity Build something that does not exist yet: The unique aspects of this optical system mean it is impossible to buy off the shelf Bench to orbit: Your hardware will fly. You will take this from optics on a breadboard to a space-qualified optical terminal Build the space internet: Work on technology that will fundamentally change how space networks operate Our Vision and Values Ephemeris Net's vision is to enable an open, space internet that anyone can utilize and access. We believe that access to better digital connectivity is essential for human progress and that space is the frontier of digital connectivity. We believe that collaboration within market competition is the most effective way to expand the internet into space. Using Ephemeris Net to build space network solutions is how we can proliferate digital connectivity, collaboration, and "the raising of all boats" while achieving a commercial impact. We Care Deeply About Access to connectivity for all Collaboration that raises all boats; we focus on win/win deals Commercial impact: building solutions people value and buy Personal growth and creating a place where people build their careers Putting good out into the world through the work we do and our interactions with each other We are building a company people feel great about working at. We are seeking people who are open and actively seeking growth—both technical and personal. We value honesty, creativity, and a culture of ownership. About Our Locations El Segundo, CA : Located in the heart of the aerospace industry, surrounded by SpaceX, Aerospace Corporation, Northrop Grumman, and hundreds of space startups. A unique ecosystem where strangers on the street are excited about space. Oakland, CA: Right off BART. Close collaboration opportunities with UC Berkeley and the broader Bay Area networking and space research communities. Ephemeris Net is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

review_candidates.title: Site Civil Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job description: At METLEN Energy & Metals , we are catalysts for a sustainable future, positioned at the forefront of the energy transition while being a reference point for competitive green metallurgy at both the European and global levels. We are a global industrial and energy company operating across two highly interconnected and complementary sectors: Energy and Metals . With a consolidated turnover of €5,683 million and an EBITDA of €1,080 million, along with a workforce of over 7,627 dedicated individuals, we drive success through cutting-edge technology and diverse talent. We are committed to embracing new state-of-the-art technologies and advancements, propelling us towards a cleaner, brighter tomorrow. Our positive footprint extends across five continents, creating a lasting impact. At METLEN, we foster a culture of resilience, challenge, respect, excellence, and change , empowering our diverse workforce to achieve remarkable outcomes. Civil Site Engineer We are currently looking for a Civil Site Engineer to join the Grid & Digital Solutions department, as part of the Thermal Power & HVDC division of Metlen, for the EGL1 Project, based in Murton. Your role will encompass: Supervising and coordinating the daily activities of subcontractors. Ensuring work is completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. Reviewing and interpreting construction plans and drawings. Enforcing site safety regulations and procedures. Conducting inspections and quality checks. Reporting on progress and issues to Project Managers. Supporting Construction Engineering with the development of civil construction work packages. Attending and providing input into site constructability review sessions. Providing engineering deliverable reviews as and when required. Supporting and providing input into scheduling sessions to help develop the Primavera project schedule. Tracking and expediting design work package deliverables from external partners. Managing and coordinating construction defects identified during construction and handover phases. Reviewing and responding to technical queries raised by civil contractors. What you bring to the role: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering. 1–2 years of experience in construction. Experience in supervising and monitoring subcontractors. Ability to work on site. Experience in industry or energy-related projects. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Effective communication and interpersonal skills. Share the same Value Based Behaviors: People & Personal Growth. Results Orientation & Safety Excellence. Collaboration & Trust. Empathy & Effective Communication. Flexibility & Adaptability. Follow us on LinkedIn and stay updated on our latest news We respect your personal data. All personal information in your application and CV will remain strictly confidential. At Metlen Energy & Metals we are proud to have Diversity and Inclusion at the centre of everything we do. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity regardless of race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or religion. jeremy.cook@metlen.com
